svg.title: Sequence of the two hal/write requests
svg.desc: The Client sends hal/write 150 percent to the Hub. The Hub asks the Safety Kernel to check it against desk-fan.hal.yaml, the kernel blocks it as above the maximum, and the Hub answers error -32010 LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The Client sends hal/write 60 percent. The kernel grants it with a single-use grant, the Hub passes the write and the grant to the Driver, the Driver sets the Device to 60 percent and reads back 60 percent, the Hub answers result done and sends a hal/value notification.
